A cliff of {tokens[0]} tokens was unlocked from Genesis Liquidity Pool on {timestamp}

notes: After Epoch 67, emissions are controlled by the Aero Fed where veAERO voters decide to increase, decrease, or maintain emission rates.

Sections Airdrop for veVELO Lockers, Ecosystem Pairs and Public Goods, Team Initial Mint, and Protocol Grants are distributed as veAERO (vote-locked). Auto Max-Locked portions remain locked for 4 years unless auto-max-lock is disabled. These sections are marked TBD as unlock depends on individual lock expiry.
Gauge, Rebase and Team Emissions are tracked onchain.

insiders.methodology: Tracks the team wallet receiving 5% of weekly emissions from the Minter. Received is a running total of an ongoing emission, not a fixed allocation. Staked tracks AERO locked into veAERO.

Airdrop for veVELO Lockers.methodology: 200M AERO airdropped as veAERO to Velodrome veVELO lockers at launch. Tokens remain vote-locked with no fixed release schedule.

airdrop-vevelo.name: Airdrop for veVELO Lockers
airdrop-vevelo.methodology: 200M AERO distributed as veAERO at launch; unlock schedule depends on individual lock expiry.

Ecosystem Pairs and Public Goods.methodology: 105M AERO allocated as veAERO for ecosystem pairs and public goods. Auto max-locked with no fixed release schedule.

public-goods.name: Ecosystem Pairs and Public Goods
public-goods.methodology: 105M AERO allocated as veAERO, auto max-locked for 4 years with no defined unlock schedule.

Team Initial Mint.methodology: 95M AERO allocated as veAERO to the foundation/team at launch. Auto max-locked with no fixed release schedule.

team-funding.name: Team Initial Mint
team-funding.methodology: 95M AERO allocated as veAERO, auto max-locked for 4 years with no defined unlock schedule.

Protocol Grants.methodology: 50M AERO allocated as veAERO for protocol grants. Auto max-locked with no fixed release schedule.

protocol-grants.name: Protocol Grants
protocol-grants.methodology: 50M AERO allocated as veAERO, auto max-locked for 4 years with no defined unlock schedule.

Gauge Emissions.methodology: Tracks AERO distributed from the Minter to the Voter contract each epoch for LP gauge rewards.

gauge-rewards.name: LP Gauge Rewards
gauge-rewards.methodology: AERO transferred from Minter to Voter contract, tracked via Transfer events on Base.

Rebase Emissions.methodology: Tracks AERO distributed from the Minter to the RewardsDistributor for veAERO rebase, reducing vote power dilution for lockers.

veaero-rebase.name: veAERO Rebase
veaero-rebase.methodology: AERO transferred from Minter to RewardsDistributor, tracked via Transfer events on Base.

Team Emissions.methodology: 5% of weekly emissions minted to the team address from the Minter contract.

team-emissions.name: Team 5% Cut
team-emissions.methodology: AERO transferred from Minter to team address, tracked via Transfer events on Base.
